title: exp.speedtest.config/1
description: Config of the exp-speedtest component (12 section 7.5 + CR-m6-spec-resolutions). The speedtest is its own component type co-located with probe + collector + runner on ONE core/DC box (the all-in-one profile). Transport: plain HTTP by default (TCP 80 on serve.listen_ip when tls.mode = none); TCP 443 (+ 80 -> 443 redirect) only when tls.mode = provided. Creds (never in this document): collector_token (exps_), runner_channel_token_sha256 (sha256 of the runner's expl_ token), tls.key/tls.crt when tls.mode = provided.

speedtest_id.description: Identity bound to the exps_ token.

zones.description: Zone directory (labels). Zones are resolved by correlation; a QR ?z=<id> only stamps a hint.

subnets.description: Longest-prefix match; client subnet -> coarse zone (identity fallback, 12 5.1).

zone_labels.description: Subnet to zone label table (the correlation fallback).

logo_artifact.description: art_ id of the logo artifact (PNG/SVG/JPEG <= 256 KiB); the desired state's component assets[] carries the download (CR-m6-contracts).

languages.description: BCP 47 language tags the page offers; the first is the default.

copy.description: Page copy overrides keyed by string id (start_button, verdict_good, ...).

version.description: Incremented by the manager whenever the text changes; stored with every test.

consent.description: Consent panel shown before the first test (device and traffic metadata are recorded for network diagnostics).

show_network_details.description: Show AP name and channel to the user (default false).

max_concurrent_tests.description: Total concurrent tests per box. Default 20 (CR-m6-spec-resolutions).

bytes_local.description: On-network byte cap per test. Default 200e6 (the 4.4 core-bandwidth guard supersedes 400 MB).

bytes_internet.description: Internet byte cap per test. Default 200e6.

result_deadline_s.description: Seconds after session creation within which the result may be submitted. Default 180.

paused.description: Admin switch 'Pause internet leg' (e.g. during a keynote).

auto_pause_wan_util_pct.description: Pause the internet leg while the runner's EC WAN utilization is above this (default 80).

internet_leg.description: Internet leg (browser -> Cloudflare's public speed-test endpoints).

placement.description: Informational; the box must be where attendee VLANs reach it routed and un-NAT'd (D15).

listen_ip.description: The box's routed interface address. HTTP/HTTPS and the DNS-leg server bind here.

require_real_client_ip.description: D15 hard requirement: when true an observed client IP outside every client_subnets entry fails identity closed (nat_suspected).

translated_addresses.description: Known NAT/edge/translated addresses: a client IP equal to one of these fails identity closed.

port.description: Tests/dev only. Production leaves it unset: 80 when tls.mode = none; 443 (+ 80 -> 443 redirect) when provided.

serve.description: Where and how the box serves.

tls.description: none = plain HTTP (default, D15); provided = tls.crt/tls.key creds. Self-signed is not offered.

port.description: Tests/dev only; production is UDP+TCP 53 on serve.listen_ip.

dns_leg.description: Authoritative DNS-leg server: answers only 'zone' (e.g. t.speed.summit.example), no recursion, rate-limited (SR-22). Needs an NS delegation of the zone to the box; without it the page falls back to the probe's DNS line (flag dns_fallback).

path.description: Hops the box times (SR-22: only these and the requesting client). Infrastructure context, not per-user.

retention_days.description: Tests, device metadata and evidence kept this long (default 30). Aggregates in VictoriaMetrics are kept forever.

scrub_after_diagnosis.description: Drop raw IP/MAC/username/hostname after the final diagnosis, keep device_key (default false, privacy sign-off decides).

privacy.description: The manager compiles the same values into collector.config speedtests and runner.config correlation.privacy.

util_pct.description: Shrink on-network sizes while this interface's utilization is above it (default 70).

min_bytes.description: Floor of the adaptive on-network size (default 5e6).

core_guard.description: Core-bandwidth guard (12 4.4): auto-shrink the on-network transfer when the core-facing interface is busy.

collector.description: The collector on the same host (results, status read).

local_channel.description: Runner -> speedtest channel (127.0.0.1 only, expl_ token): Mist 'where' cache and internet-leg auto-pause.
